_note: C349 v3.1 Beat B: TESSA, Parasol Lady storm-chaser on Route 119 (slot 117, reclaimed from never-battled TRAINER_CINDY_2). Optional postgame trainer (GAME_CLEAR + LOTAD_HOENN caught), not a boss. Her script sets WEATHER_RAIN_THUNDERSTORM before the battle, so the fight is in permanent rain and Thunder skips the accuracy check (battle_script_commands.c ~1089): rule sentence 'In the rain, my THUNDER never misses!'. No Rain Dance/Sunny Day on anyone; Thunder on Lombre_H + Ludicolo_H only; Lotad_H is the no-Thunder utility lead. Levels 55/57/59: just above the Champion (53-57) and below Wattson_4 (Ludicolo_H 61) and the Reckoning bosses (64-67). Ability: trainer mons use slot 0 = LIGHTNING_ROD, which has no effect in Gen 3 singles; nothing is designed around it (Rain Dish, slot 1, is never used). Move legality hand-checked with rom_species C349 (no lint): LOTAD_HOENN TOXIC TM06, PROTECT TM17, GIGA_DRAIN L43/TM19, SHOCK_WAVE L31/TM34; LOMBRE_HOENN FAKE_OUT L19, THUNDER TM25, THUNDER_WAVE L25, GIGA_DRAIN L49/TM19; LUDICOLO_HOENN (level-up is Lv1 only) THUNDER TM25, GIGA_DRAIN TM19, TOXIC TM06, PROTECT TM17. No held items, no trainer items. trainerClass/encounterMusic/trainerPic/trainerName/items/doubleBattle/aiFlags are documentation: modify mode does NOT write them, so hand-edit them into the [TRAINER_ROUTE119_STORM_CHASER] block. Apply with: node scripts/generate_trainer.cjs scripts/trainer_configs/route119_storm_chaser.json
